description: A JSON or YAML description of every operation, parameter and response of an HTTP API that tools use to render docs and generate clients.
The first-party package whose `AddOpenApi` and `MapOpenApi` generate and serve the document, at `/openapi/v1.json` by default.
The specification version that .NET 10 generates by default, aligned with JSON Schema, so nullable types appear as a `type` array with `null`.
A document, operation or schema callback registered on `OpenApiOptions` that edits the generated document, for example to set the title or a security scheme.
A contract change that can fail an existing client, such as removing or renaming a field, changing its type or making an input required.
The MIT-licensed package from the `dotnet` organization that adds API versioning to minimal APIs through version sets such as `NewVersionedApi().MapGroup(...).HasApiVersion(1.0)`.
Writing the OpenAPI file during `dotnet build` with `Microsoft.Extensions.ApiDescription.Server` and `OpenApiGenerateDocumentsOnBuild`, so the contract can be diffed in reviews.
